skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic concepts of business and business management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand fundamental concepts related to business and business management.
Students will develop independent work skills, discipline, teamwork, communication skills, and problem-solving abilities.
Students will have the ability to independently study, accumulate and enhance their professional knowledge, adapt to different working environments, and take initiative in their work.
Students will understand and recognize the business environment and its factors, including social responsibility and business ethics.
Students will understand the role, functions, skills, art, style of managers.
Students will understand the basics of managing various business activities within a company.
Students will learn how to assess business results and effectiveness using various indicators and standards.
